fact: On 13 March 2024, at the first meeting of the reconstituted Supreme Council for Digital Society, the Prime Minister named approval of the national strategy for building an integrated digital state as one of the Council's objectives, i.e. not yet approved, while the same meeting adopted and launched the cloud computing policy in line with the 'Digital Egypt' strategy.
title: رئيس الوزراء يترأس الاجتماع الأول للمجلس الأعلى للمجتمع الرقمي بعد إعادة تشكيله
